campaigns_window_ordered.name: campaigns_window_ordered
campaigns_window_ordered.value: "access_code_campaigns"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "access_code_campaigns"."expires_at" IS NULL OR "access_code_campaigns"."starts_at" < "access_code_campaigns"."expires_at"

credit_ledger_sign_matches_type.name: credit_ledger_sign_matches_type
credit_ledger_sign_matches_type.value:
("credit_ledger"."type" IN ('EARLY_ACCESS_GRANT','PROMOTIONAL_GRANT','ADMIN_GRANT') AND "credit_ledger"."amount" > 0)
        OR ("credit_ledger"."type" IN ('ADMIN_DEDUCTION','EXPIRY') AND "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0)
        OR ("credit_ledger"."type" = 'REVERSAL')
        OR ("credit_ledger"."type" IN ('PURCHASE','GENERATION_RESERVE','GENERATION_CAPTURE','GENERATION_RELEASE','PAYMENT_REFUND'))
